# Surface

Generic styled box when Card's structure is too much: variant surface | panel | muted | none, plus radius, padding (inset tokens) and elevation.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `surface.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library. Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
